en.t: Maya queen Yohl Ik'nal is crowned ruler of Palenque
en.s: Yohl Ikʼnal (Mayan pronunciation: [johl ikʼnal]), also known as Lady Kan Ik, Lady Kʼanal Ikʼnal, and sometimes rendered as Ix Yohl Ikʼnal (died 7 November 604), was queen regnant of the Maya city-state of Palenque (ancient Lakamha). She acceded to the throne on 23 December 583 CE and ruled until her death in 604.

zh.t: 玛雅女王约尔·伊克纳尔登上帕伦克王位
zh.s: 约尔·伊克纳尔（又称Kan Ik夫人、Kʼanal Ik夫人，有时也写作Ix Yohl Ikʼnal；604年11月7日去世）是玛雅城邦帕伦克（古称拉坎哈）的女王。她于公元583年12月23日登基，统治至604年去世。

en.n: The Ilkhanate ruler Ghazan defeats a Mamluk army that opposes his invasion into Syria in the Battle of Wadi al-Khaznadar near Homs.

zh.s: 1299年，蒙古军在瓦迪·哈兹纳达尔战役中击败马穆鲁克军队；这场战斗也称第三次霍姆斯战役。
zh.n: 伊儿汗国统治者合赞在霍姆斯附近击败一支阻挡其入侵叙利亚的马穆鲁克军队。

en.s: The siege of al-Rahba was a military engagement between the invading Ilkhanate Mongols and the Egyptian Mamluk al-Rahba garrison. It was the last military engagement of the Mamluk-Ilkhanid War. In 1312, the Mamluk sultan of Egypt, al-Nasir Muhammad, began forming his own Mamluk emirs instead of Syrian ones. Having formed 46 new Emirs, he began eliminating the Emirs who had brought him to power.

zh.s: 这是入侵的伊儿汗国蒙古军与埃及马穆鲁克驻军之间的一次交战，也是马穆鲁克—伊儿汗国战争中的最后一场军事交锋。1312年，埃及马穆鲁克苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德开始任用自己提拔的马穆鲁克埃米尔，而非叙利亚人选。他任命46名新埃米尔后，开始清除曾助他掌权的埃米尔。

en.s: The Battle of Curalaba (Spanish: Batalla de Curalaba pronounced [baˈtaʝa ðe kuɾaˈlaβa]) was a battle and an ambush in 1598 when Mapuche people led by Pelantaru defeated Spanish conquerors led by Martín García Óñez de Loyola at Curalaba, southern Chile. In Chilean historiography, where the event is often called the Disaster of Curalaba (Spanish: Desastre de Curalaba), the battle marks the end of the conquest (la conquista) period in Chile's history, although the fast Spanish expansion in the south had already been halted in the 1550s.
en.n: Arauco War: Governor of Chile Martín García Óñez de Loyola is killed in the Battle of Curalaba by Mapuches led by Pelantaru.

zh.s: 1598年，由佩兰塔鲁率领的马普切人在智利南部库拉拉瓦设伏，击败由智利总督马丁·加西亚·奥涅斯·德·洛约拉率领的西班牙征服者。在智利史学界，这场战役常被称为“库拉拉瓦灾难”，并标志着智利征服时期结束；不过，西班牙人向南快速扩张的势头早在1550年代就已受阻。
zh.n: 阿劳科战争期间，智利总督马丁·加西亚·奥涅斯·德·洛约拉在库拉拉瓦战役中被佩兰塔鲁率领的马普切人杀死。

en.t: As part of the Glorious Revolution, King James II of England flees from England to Paris after being deposed in favor of his son-in-law and nephew, William of Orange and his daughter Mary
en.s: James II and VII (14 October 1633 O.S. – 16 September 1701) was King of England and Ireland as James II and King of Scotland as James VII from February 1685 until he was deposed in the 1688 Glorious Revolution. The last Catholic monarch of England, Scotland, and Ireland, his reign was marked by conflicts over religion, absolutism and the divine right of kings; his deposition ended a century of political and civil strife by confirming the primacy of the English Parliament over the Crown.

zh.t: 光荣革命期间，詹姆斯二世遭废黜后逃往巴黎
zh.s: 詹姆斯二世（苏格兰称詹姆斯七世；1633年10月14日〔旧历〕—1701年9月16日）自1685年2月起担任英格兰和爱尔兰国王及苏格兰国王，直至1688年光荣革命中被废黜。他是英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰最后一位天主教君主；其统治因宗教、专制主义和君权神授问题而冲突不断。他的下台结束了持续一个世纪的政治与内乱，并确认议会地位高于王权。

en.t: Moscow State Academy of Choreography is founded under the reign of Catherine II. It is the second ballet school in Russia after Vaganova Academy of Russian Ballet
en.s: The Moscow State Academy of Choreography (Russian: Московская государственная академия хореографии), commonly known as the Bolshoi Ballet Academy, is a ballet school located in Moscow, Russia. It is the affiliate school of the Bolshoi Ballet. Founded on December 23, 1773 as the second ballet school in Russia, it entered into a contract with the Italian teacher-choreographer Filippo Becari, regarded as the "most capable of teaching" children to learn to "dance with all possible precision and to show themselves publicly in all pantomime ballets".

zh.t: 莫斯科国立舞蹈学院成立
zh.s: 莫斯科国立舞蹈学院位于莫斯科，也称莫斯科大剧院芭蕾舞学院，是莫斯科大剧院的附属学校。学院于1773年12月23日成立，是俄罗斯第二所芭蕾舞学校，仅次于瓦冈诺娃俄罗斯芭蕾舞学院。学院随后与意大利教师兼编舞家菲利波·贝卡里签订合同，邀请这位被称为“最有能力的教师”教授儿童舞蹈，要求学生动作准确，并能公开表演哑剧芭蕾。

en.t: George Washington resigns command of the Continental Army
en.s: George Washington resigned his commission as commander-in-chief of the Continental Army to the Confederation Congress at the Maryland State House in Annapolis on December 23. After the American Revolutionary War, his voluntary return to civilian life became an influential example of civilian authority over the military.

zh.t: 乔治·华盛顿辞去大陆军总司令职务
zh.s: 1783年12月23日，乔治·华盛顿在安纳波利斯的马里兰州议会大厦向邦联国会递交辞呈，辞去大陆军总司令职务。美国独立战争结束后，他主动回归平民生活，成为军队服从文官权力的重要先例。

en.s: The Battle of Savenay took place on 23 December 1793, and marks the end of the Virée de Galerne operational phase of the first war in the Vendée after the French Revolution. A Republican force of approximately 18,000 decisively defeated the Armée Catholique et Royale force of 6,000 at Savenay.

zh.s: 萨韦奈战役于1793年12月23日爆发，标志着法国大革命后第一次旺代战争中“加朗之旅”（Virée de Galerne）作战阶段结束。约1.8万名共和军在萨韦奈决定性击败了约6,000人的天主教王党军。

en.s: The siege of Landau (20 August – 23 December 1793) saw a corps from the Kingdom of Prussia commanded by Frederick Louis, Prince of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen lay siege to a 3,800-man French Republican garrison led by Joseph Marie Tennet de Laubadère. Since the Prussians lacked siege cannons, they tried to starve the French defenders into surrender by blockading the city.

en.s: The Battle of Collioure (20–23 December 1793) saw troops from Spain attack a French division during the War of the Pyrenees. The Spanish troops led by Gregorio García de la Cuesta were completely successful in ousting the French under Louis Pierre François Delattre from Collioure, Fort Saint-Elme and Port-Vendres. The contending sides were the Spanish Army of Catalonia commanded by Antonio Ricardos and the French Army of the Eastern Pyrenees led by François Amédée Doppet and Eustache Charles d'Aoust.

en.s: The Battle of Czarnowo on the night of 23–24 December 1806 saw troops of the First French Empire under the eye of Emperor Napoleon I launch an evening assault crossing of the Wkra River against Lieutenant General Alexander Ivanovich Ostermann-Tolstoy's defending Russian Empire forces. The attackers, part of Marshal Louis-Nicolas Davout's III Corps, succeeded in crossing the Wkra at its mouth and pressed eastward to the village of Czarnowo. After an all-night struggle, the Russian commander withdrew his troops to the east, ending this War of the Fourth Coalition action. Czarnowo is located on the north bank of the Narew River 33 kilometres (21 mi) north-northwest of Warsaw.

zh.s: 1806年12月23日至24日夜，法兰西第一帝国军队在拿破仑一世注视下，于夜间强渡乌克拉河，进攻亚历山大·伊万诺维奇·奥斯特曼-托尔斯泰率领的俄罗斯帝国守军。进攻部队隶属达武元帅的第三军，在河口成功渡河后向东推进至恰尔诺沃村。经过整夜战斗，俄军指挥官率部东撤，这场第四次反法同盟战争中的战斗就此结束。恰尔诺沃位于纳雷夫河北岸，在华沙以北偏西北约33公里处。

en.s: The Walcheren Campaign (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈʋɑlxərə(n)]) was an unsuccessful British expedition to the Kingdom of Holland in 1809 intended to open another front in the Austrian Empire's struggle with France during the War of the Fifth Coalition. John Pitt, 2nd Earl of Chatham, the commander of the expedition, was ordered to capture the towns of Flushing (Vlissingen) and Antwerp and thus enable British ships to safely traverse the Scheldt River.

en.s: The Battle of Holy Ground, or Battle of Econochaca, was a battle fought on December 23, 1813 between the United States militia and the Red Stick Creek Indians during the Creek War. The battle took place at Econochaca, the site of a fortified encampment established in the summer of 1813 by Josiah Francis on a bluff above the Alabama River, in what is now Lowndes County, Alabama. It was one of three encampments erected by Red Stick Creeks that summer. In addition to the physical defenses, Creek prophets performed ceremonies at the site to create a spiritual barrier of protection.

zh.s: 圣地战役又称Econochaca战役，于1813年12月23日在美国民兵与克里克战争中的红棍派克里克人之间爆发。战场位于Econochaca的一处设防营地。约西亚·弗朗西斯于1813年夏天在阿拉巴马河上方的河岸高地建起这座营地；这是当年红棍派克里克人修建的三处营地之一。除实体防御外，克里克先知还在此举行仪式，祈求形成一道精神屏障。

en.t: The novel Emma by Jane Austen is first published
en.s: Emma is a novel written by English author Jane Austen. It is set in the fictional Surrey village of Highbury and the surrounding estates of Hartfield, Randalls, and Donwell Abbey, and involves the relationships among people from a small number of families. The novel was first published in December 1815, although the title page is dated 1816.

zh.t: 简·奥斯汀的小说《爱玛》首次出版
zh.s: 《爱玛》是英国作家简·奥斯汀所著的小说，故事发生在萨里郡虚构的海伯里村及周边庄园哈特菲尔德、兰德尔斯和唐维尔修道院，描写几个家庭之间的人际关系。小说于1815年12月23日首次出版，但书名页标注的年份是1816年。

en.t: The poem "Account of a Visit from St. Nicholas," also known as "'Twas the Night Before Christmas," is published anonymously in the Troy Sentinel
en.s: "A Visit from St. Nicholas" (often called "The Night Before Christmas" and "'Twas the Night Before Christmas", from its first line) is a poem, first published anonymously under the title "Account of a Visit from St. Nicholas", in 1823. Authorship has been attributed to Clement Clarke Moore, who claimed authorship in 1837; but it has also been suggested that Henry Livingston Jr. wrote it.

zh.t: 《圣诞老人的来访》匿名发表于《特洛伊哨兵报》
zh.s: 《圣诞老人的来访》也常称《圣诞夜前》（取自诗歌首句），1823年以《圣尼古拉斯来访记》为题首次匿名发表。克莱门特·克拉克·摩尔于1837年声称自己是作者，但也有人认为作者是小亨利·利文斯顿。

en.s: The siege of Antwerp took place after fighting in the Belgian Revolution ended. On 15 November 1832, the French Armée du Nord under Marshal Gérard began to lay siege to the Dutch troops there under David Chassé. The siege ended on 23 December 1832. The French had agreed with the Belgian rebels that the latter would not participate in the battle.

en.s: The Dutch–Venezuelan crisis of 1908 was a dispute that broke out between the Netherlands and Venezuela after the Venezuelan president, Cipriano Castro, issued a number of decrees that undermined trade with the Dutch Caribbean island of Curaçao. Venezuela expelled the Dutch ambassador, prompting a Dutch dispatch of three warships: Jacob van Heemskerck, Gelderland, and Friesland. The Dutch warships had orders to intercept every ship that was sailing under the Venezuelan flag.

en.t: The Federal Reserve Act is signed into law by President Woodrow Wilson, creating the Federal Reserve System
en.s: The Federal Reserve Act was passed by the 63rd United States Congress and signed into law by President Woodrow Wilson on December 23, 1913. The law created the Federal Reserve System, the central banking system of the United States. Following the 1912 elections, in which Democrats gained control of Congress and the presidency, President Wilson, Congressman Carter Glass, and Senator Robert Latham Owen introduced legislation to create a central bank.

zh.t: 伍德罗·威尔逊总统签署《联邦储备法》，美国联邦储备系统由此成立
zh.s: 《联邦储备法》经美国第63届国会通过后，由总统伍德罗·威尔逊于1913年12月23日签署生效，创建了美国中央银行体系——联邦储备系统。1912年选举后，民主党同时掌控国会和总统职位；威尔逊、众议员卡特·格拉斯和参议员罗伯特·拉瑟姆·欧文随后提出建立中央银行的法案。

en.t: World War I: During the Battle of Sarikamish, Ottoman forces mistook one another for Russian troops. The following friendly fire incident leaves 2,000 Ottomans dead and many more wounded
en.s: The Battle of Sarikamish was an engagement between the Russian and Ottoman Empires during World War I. It took place from 22 December 1914, to 17 January 1915, as part of the Caucasus campaign. The battle resulted in a decisive Russian victory. The Ottoman plan relied on highly mobile troops capable of reaching specific objectives at precise times, drawing on German and Napoleonic tactical principles.

zh.t: 第一次世界大战：萨勒卡默什战役中，奥斯曼军误将友军当作俄军；随后误击造成2000人死亡、多人受伤
zh.s: 萨勒卡默什战役是第一次世界大战期间俄罗斯帝国与奥斯曼帝国之间的交战，发生于1914年12月22日至1915年1月17日，属于高加索战役的一部分。战斗以俄军决定性胜利告终。奥斯曼计划依靠机动部队准时抵达指定目标，并借鉴德国和拿破仑时期的战术原则。

en.t: ANZAC forces win the Battle of Magdhaba in Sinai
en.s: The ANZAC Mounted Division and the Imperial Camel Corps attacked Ottoman forces at Magdhaba in the northern Sinai on December 23. Their victory removed an outpost blocking the route toward Palestine. The battle took place in the Asian part of present-day Egypt.

zh.t: 澳新军团在西奈半岛赢得马格达巴战役
zh.s: 1916年12月23日，澳新军团骑兵师和帝国骆驼兵团在西奈半岛北部马格达巴进攻奥斯曼军队，并取得胜利，拔除了一处阻挡通往巴勒斯坦道路的据点。战场位于今埃及的亚洲部分。

en.s: The Battle of Punapargi (Estonian: Punapargi lahing) was a skirmish during the Estonian Independence War between Estonian soldiers of the 6th Infantry Regiment and the retreating Imperial German forces near Punapargi in Pärnu County on 23 December 1918.

zh.s: 1918年12月23日，爱沙尼亚独立战争期间，爱沙尼亚第六步兵团在帕尔努县潘纳帕尔吉附近与正在撤退的德意志帝国军队发生交战。

en.t: Sex Disqualification (Removal) Act 1919 becomes law in the United Kingdom, allowing women to serve as lawyers, civil servants, and in other professions, as well as to serve on juries
en.s: The Sex Disqualification (Removal) Act 1919 (9 & 10 Geo. 5. c. 71) was an act of the Parliament of the United Kingdom. It became law when it received royal assent on 23 December 1919. The act enabled women to join the professions and professional bodies, to sit on juries and be awarded degrees. It was a government compromise, a replacement for a more radical private members' bill, the Women's Emancipation Bill.

zh.t: 英国《1919年取消性别资格限制法》生效
zh.s: 英国议会于1919年通过《取消性别资格限制法》（9 & 10 Geo. 5. c. 71），并于1919年12月23日获御准生效。该法允许女性进入各类职业和专业团体、担任陪审员并取得学位。这是政府作出的妥协方案，取代了更激进的私人议员法案《妇女解放法案》。

en.s: The Catalonia Offensive (Catalan: Ofensiva de Catalunya, Spanish: Ofensiva de Cataluña) was part of the Spanish Civil War. The Nationalist Army started the offensive on 23 December 1938 and rapidly conquered Republican-held Catalonia with Barcelona (the Republic's capital city from October 1937). Barcelona was captured on 26 January 1939. The Republican and Catalan governments headed for the French border.

zh.s: 加泰罗尼亚攻势是西班牙内战的一部分。国民军于1938年12月23日发动攻势，迅速攻占共和派控制的加泰罗尼亚地区；巴塞罗那自1937年10月起是共和国首都。1939年1月26日，巴塞罗那被攻占，共和国政府和加泰罗尼亚政府随后向法国边境撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Wake Island was a battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II, fought on Wake Island. The assault was one of five simultaneous assaults on American naval and air bases in the Pacific on the morning of 8 December 1941 (7 December in Hawaii), with the Battle of Wake Island ending on 23 December, with the surrender of American forces to the Empire of Japan.

zh.s: 威克岛战役是第二次世界大战太平洋战场的一场战斗。日本于1941年12月8日清晨发动进攻，这是针对美国在太平洋的海军和空军基地的五场同步攻击之一。战役于12月23日结束，美军向日本帝国投降。

en.s: The Japanese invasion of Lamon Bay (Filipino: Paglusob ng mga Hapones sa Look ng Lamon) was a secondary mission in the Japanese invasion of Lingayen Gulf during the 1941-1942 Japanese conquest of the Philippines. Securing the coast southeast of Manila would complete the Japanese encirclement of the capital and would act as a diversionary attack from the Japanese main invasion force from the north.

zh.s: 这是1941—1942年日本征服菲律宾期间入侵林加延湾行动的一项辅助任务。控制马尼拉东南海岸可完成对首都的包围，并牵制北部的日军主力。

en.s: The Japanese invasion of Lingayen Gulf was the key point in the Japanese plan for the conquest of the Philippines. Preparations had already been made by the Attack on Clark Field and the landings of Japanese forces at five points in northern and southern Luzon and Mindanao in early/mid December 1941, with the IJAAF seizing air fields and basing aircraft for ground support, and the Imperial Japanese Navy establishing seaplane bases at the Camiguin Island, Legaspi, and Davao.

zh.s: 入侵林加延湾是日军征服菲律宾计划的关键环节。此前，日军袭击克拉克机场，并于1941年12月上中旬在吕宋岛南北部及棉兰老岛五处登陆；日本陆军航空队夺取机场并部署地面支援飞机，日本帝国海军则在卡米金岛、黎牙实比和达沃建立水上飞机基地。

en.s: Convoy HG 76 (19 to 23 December 1941) was an Allied convoy of the HG (Homeward from Gibraltar) series, during the Second World War. It was notable for the destruction of five German U-boats, although the true total was not known to the British until after the war. Two Condor long-range reconnaissance aircraft were shot down by British Martlet fighters from the escort carrier HMS Audacity, which was sunk later on the voyage, along with a destroyer and two merchant ships.

zh.s: HG 76号船队于1941年12月19日至23日从直布罗陀驶往英国，是第二次世界大战期间“HG”系列盟军返航船队之一。此次护航行动击沉了5艘德国潜艇，但英方直到战后才确认确切数量。来自护航航母“奥达西号”的英国“马特莱特”战斗机还击落了两架长程侦察机“秃鹰”。随后，“奥达西号”、一艘驱逐舰和两艘商船也在航程中沉没。

en.s: Operation Winter Storm (German: Unternehmen Wintergewitter) was a German offensive in December 1942 during World War II, in which the German 4th Panzer Army failed to break the Soviet encirclement of the German 6th Army during the Battle of Stalingrad. In late November 1942, the Red Army completed Operation Uranus, encircling some 300,000 Axis personnel in and around the city of Stalingrad.

zh.s: 冬季风暴行动（德语：Unternehmen Wintergewitter）是二战期间德国于1942年12月发动的攻势，德国第4装甲军团未能突破苏军对斯大林格勒德军第6集团军的包围。1942年11月下旬，红军完成“天王星行动”，将斯大林格勒城内外约30万轴心国军队包围。

en.s: The Copa de Oro Argentina was a Spanish football competition, held once on 23 December 1945 as a one-off game between FC Barcelona (winner of the 1944–45 La Liga) and Athletic Bilbao (winner of the 1944–45 Copa del Generalísimo), with Barcelona winning 5–4 at their Camp de Les Corts stadium. The match was organised by the Catalan Football Federation on the initiative of the Argentine consulate in Barcelona, with the trophy being provided by the city's Argentine community.

zh.s: 阿根廷金杯赛是西班牙的一次性足球赛事，于1945年12月23日举行。巴塞罗那足球俱乐部作为1944—45赛季西甲冠军，对阵西班牙杯冠军毕尔巴鄂竞技，并在主场莱斯科尔茨球场以5比4获胜。比赛由加泰罗尼亚足球联合会组织，发起方是阿根廷驻巴塞罗那领事馆，奖杯由当地阿根廷侨民提供。

en.t: First successful kidney transplant is performed by J. Hartwell Harrison and Joseph Murray
en.s: Kidney transplant or renal transplant is the organ transplant of a kidney into a patient with end-stage kidney disease (ESRD). Kidney transplant is typically classified as deceased-donor (formerly known as cadaveric) or living-donor transplantation depending on the source of the donor organ. Living-donor kidney transplants are further characterized as genetically related (living-related) or non-related (living-unrelated) transplants, depending on whether a biological relationship exists between the donor and recipient.

zh.t: J. 哈特韦尔·哈里森和约瑟夫·默里完成首例成功肾移植
zh.s: 肾移植是将肾脏移植给终末期肾病患者的器官移植手术。按供肾来源，通常分为已故捐献者（过去称尸体供者）和活体捐献者移植。活体供肾还可按供者与受者有无生物学亲缘关系，分为亲属和非亲属活体移植。

en.t: The first film adaptation of Väinö Linna's novel The Unknown Soldier, directed by Edvin Laine, premieres
en.s: Väinö Valtteri Linna (pronounced [ˈʋæi̯nø ˈlinːɑ] ; 20 December 1920 – 21 April 1992) was a Finnish author and a former soldier who fought in the Continuation War (1941–44). Linna gained literary fame with his third novel, Tuntematon sotilas (The Unknown Soldier, published in 1954), and consolidated his position with the trilogy Täällä Pohjantähden alla (Under the North Star, published in 1959–1963 and translated into English by Richard Impola).

zh.t: 埃德温·莱恩执导的首部《无名战士》电影改编版首映
zh.s: 维伊诺·瓦尔泰里·林纳（1920年12月20日—1992年4月21日）是芬兰作家，曾作为士兵参加继续战争（1941—1944年）。他的第三部小说《无名战士》（1954年出版）使他享有文学声誉；《北极星下》三部曲（1959—1963年出版，由理查德·因波拉译成英文）则巩固了他的地位。

en.t: 1957 United States Air Force incursion into Albanian airspace
en.s: The 1957 United States Air Force incursion into Albanian airspace (Albanian: Incidentet e para ajrore), was a Cold War air-to-air combat incident. On December 23, 1957, an American T-33 fighter jet violated Albanian airspace. Two MiG-15 aircraft took off from Kuçova Air Base, piloted by Anastas Ngjela and Mahmut Hysa. The American fighter jet was surrounded and forced to land on the unfinished runway at Rinas airport, now known as Tirana International Airport Nënë Tereza.

zh.t: 1957年美国空军侵犯阿尔巴尼亚领空事件
zh.s: 1957年12月23日，一架美国T-33战机侵犯阿尔巴尼亚领空。两架由阿纳斯塔斯·恩杰拉和马赫穆特·希萨驾驶的米格-15从库乔瓦空军基地起飞，包围这架美机，并迫使其降落在里纳斯机场尚未完工的跑道上。该机场现称特蕾莎修女国际机场。

en.s: The South Korean presidential election of 1972 took place on 23 December 1972, after the promulgation of the Yushin Constitution, and was won by Park Chung-hee without opposition. Under the terms of the Constitution, the President was elected not by direct vote, as had been the case formerly, but by an electoral college known as the National Council for Unification. With no opposition candidates and with the National Council hand-picked by Park, Park was elected with the support of 2,357 out of the 2,359 delegates who had been elected to the Council on December 5. Two votes were registered as invalid.

zh.s: 韩国于1972年12月23日举行总统选举，朴正熙在没有对手的情况下当选。这次选举是在《维新宪法》颁布后举行的。根据新宪法，总统不再由全民直接投票产生，而由名为统一主体国民会议的选举团选出。该会议代表由朴正熙挑选；12月5日选出的2,359名代表中，2,357人投票支持朴正熙，另有两票作废。

en.s: General elections were held in Singapore on 23 December 1976. The result was a victory for the People's Action Party, which won all 69 seats, the third of four consecutive elections in which they repeated the feat. Voter turnout was 95.1% in the 53 constituencies that were contested, with PAP candidates elected unopposed in the other sixteen.

en.s: Alitalia Flight 4128 was a scheduled flight from Leonardo da Vinci Airport, in Rome, Italy, to Palermo International Airport in Palermo, Italy, with 129 on board. On 23 December 1978, the McDonnell Douglas DC-9-32 crashed into the Tyrrhenian Sea about 3 km (1.9 mi) north of Palermo while on approach. As a result of the accident, out of 129 people (between passengers and crew), 108 perished and 21 survived, rescued by nearby fishing boats.

zh.s: 意大利航空4128号班机原定从罗马达芬奇机场飞往巴勒莫国际机场，机上共有129人。1978年12月23日，麦道DC-9-32客机在降落途中坠入第勒尼安海，地点在巴勒莫以北约3公里。机上108人遇难，21人获救，救援者是附近的渔船船员。

en.s: General elections were held in Singapore on 23 December 1980. The result was a victory for the People's Action Party, which won all 75 seats, the last of four consecutive elections in which they repeated the feat. Voter turnout was 95.5%, although this figure represents the turnout in the 38 constituencies to be contested, with PAP candidates earning walkovers in the other 37. Abolished constituencies do include: * Farrer Park. Merged with Moulmein. Lee Chiaw Meng was shifted to Tanah Merah from Farrer Park (in view of new development) * Geylang East. Merged with MacPherson. Ho Cheng Choon retired.

zh.s: 新加坡于1980年12月23日举行大选。人民行动党赢得全部75个议席，这是该党连续第四届大选包揽所有议席。投票率为95.5%，不过这个数字只按38个有竞争的选区计算；另有37个选区因人民行动党候选人自动当选而没有对手。此次撤销的选区包括：法拉公园选区并入莫尔敏选区，李嘉明从法拉公园改到丹那美拉参选（因当地新开发）；芽笼东并入麦波申；Ho Cheng Choon退休。

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 3519 was a scheduled flight operated by a Tupolev Tu-154 from Krasnoyarsk Airport in Krasnoyatsk, Soviet Union, to Irkutsk Airport in Irkutsk, Soviet Union. On December 23, 1984, the aircraft flying this route crashed due to an engine failure. 110 occupants died; one passenger survived the accident.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Somalia on 23 December 1986, the first time a public election for President had been held. The country was a one-party state at the time, with the Somali Revolutionary Socialist Party (SRSP) as the sole legal political party. Its leader, incumbent President Siad Barre, was the only candidate. He was re-elected with fewer than 1,500 votes against his candidacy.

zh.s: 索马里于1986年12月23日举行总统选举，这是该国首次通过公开选举产生总统。当时索马里实行一党制，索马里革命社会主义党是唯一合法政党；该党领袖、时任总统西亚德·巴雷是唯一候选人。他再次当选，反对票不足1,500张。

en.s: Operation Nifty Package was a United States Delta Force and Navy SEAL-operated plan conducted in 1989 designed to capture the de facto ruler of Panama Manuel Noriega who ruled through puppet presidents. When Noriega took refuge in the Apostolic Nunciature of the Holy See (diplomatic quarter), deafening music and other psychological warfare tactics were used to convince him to exit and surrender himself.

en.s: An independence referendum was held in the Republic of Slovenia on 23 December 1990. Both the ruling centre-right coalition and the left-wing opposition supported the referendum and called on voters to support Slovenian independence. The voters were asked the question: "Should the Republic of Slovenia become an independent and sovereign state?" (Slovene: Ali naj Republika Slovenija postane samostojna in neodvisna država?). The Slovenian Parliament set a threshold for the validity of the plebiscite at 50% and one of all electors (the absolute majority).

zh.s: 1990年12月23日，斯洛文尼亚共和国举行独立公投。执政的中右翼联盟和左翼反对派都支持公投，并呼吁选民投票支持独立。公投问题是：“斯洛文尼亚共和国是否应成为一个独立、主权国家？”斯洛文尼亚议会规定，公投必须获得全体选民的绝对多数支持（超过50%）才算有效。

en.s: General elections were held in Sudan between 13 and 23 December 2000 to elect a President and National Assembly. The elections were boycotted by the main opposition parties including the Umma Party, the Democratic Unionist Party and the Popular National Congress, which resulted in an easy victory for the incumbent President Omar al-Bashir of the National Congress in the presidential election, with the National Congress also victorious the National Assembly election, winning 355 of the 360 seats, 112 of which were uncontested.

zh.s: 苏丹于2000年12月13日至23日举行大选，选举总统和国民议会。乌玛党、民主统一党和人民大会党等主要反对党抵制选举，执政的全国大会党因此轻松获胜：奥马尔·巴希尔连任总统，全国大会党也赢得国民议会选举，在360个席位中拿下355席，其中112席没有对手。

en.s: Gubernatorial elections in 2001 took place in 17 regions of the Russian Federation on various dates, including one snap election. In two regions the second rounds were held in January 2002. With some delay, elections were held for the governors of Nenets and Taymyr Autonomous Okrugs, whose terms of office expired back in December 2000. Early elections were held in Primorsky Krai after resignation of Yevgeny Nazdratenko.

en.s: The Second Battle of Fallujah, initially codenamed Operation Phantom Fury, Operation al-Fajr (Arabic: الفجر, lit. 'The Dawn') was an American-led offensive of the Iraq War that began on 7 November 2004 and lasted about six weeks. A joint military effort of the United States, the Iraqi Interim Government, and the United Kingdom, the battle was the war's first major engagement fought solely against the Iraqi insurgency, not the military forces of the Ba'athist Iraq government.

en.s: Azerbaijan Airlines Flight 217 was a scheduled passenger flight between Baku and Aktau, Kazakhstan that crashed into the Caspian Sea at ca. 22:40 on 23 December 2005. The flight was operated by an Antonov An-140.

en.s: Final Battle 2006 was a major professional wrestling event produced by Ring of Honor (ROH). It took place on December 23, 2006 from the Manhattan Center in New York City. It was the fourth annual event in the Final Battle chronology, with the first taking place in 2002. The shows main event featured New York’s own Homicide challenge Bryan Danielson for the ROH World Championship, with Homicide vowing to leave ROH forever if he failed to win the title. The show also featured Claudio Castagnoli in his final match before leaving for World Wrestling Entertainment.

zh.s: ROH于2006年12月23日在纽约市曼哈顿中心举办《终极之战2006》，这是该系列第四届年终赛事；首届于2002年举行。主赛中，纽约本地选手Homicide挑战Bryan Danielson，争夺ROH世界冠军；Homicide扬言，如果没能夺冠就永远离开ROH。Claudio Castagnoli也在本场打了离开世界摔角娱乐（WWE）前的最后一场比赛。

en.s: On 23 December 2006 and 3 January 2007, Tunisian security forces engaged in clashes with members of a group with connections to the Islamist terror group Salafist Group for Preaching and Combat (GSPC) in the towns of Soliman and Hammam-Lif south of the capital Tunis, killing more than a dozen people.

en.s: General elections were held in Thailand on 23 December 2007. They were the first elections after the Council for National Security, a military junta, had overthrown Thailand's elected government and abrogated the constitution on 19 September 2006. The junta had canceled general elections scheduled for October 2006 and promised new elections within 12 months.

en.s: The 2008 Guinean coup d'état was a Guinean military coup d'état that occurred in Guinea on 23 December 2008, shortly after the death of long-time President Lansana Conté. A junta called the National Council for Democracy and Development (Conseil National de la Démocratie et du Development, CNDD), headed by Captain Moussa Dadis Camara, seized power and announced that it planned to rule the country for two years prior to a new presidential election. Camara did indeed step down after Alpha Condé was elected in the 2010 election.

zh.s: 2008年12月23日，长期执政的总统兰萨纳·孔戴去世后不久，几内亚发生军事政变。由穆萨·达迪斯·卡马拉上尉领导的军政府——国家民主与发展委员会——夺取政权，并宣布计划执政两年后再举行总统选举。2010年阿尔法·孔戴当选后，卡马拉也确实辞去了职务。

en.s: Super J-Cup: 5th Stage – Land of Confusion was the fifth Super J-Cup professional wrestling single-elimination tournament produced by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW). It was a two-night event taking place on December 22 and December 23, 2009 at the Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. The interpromotional tournament featured junior heavyweight wrestlers from various Japanese promotions, marking its return after a five-year hiatus, last held in 2004.

zh.s: “Super J-Cup：第五阶段——混乱之地”是新日本职业摔角举办的第五届Super J-Cup单败淘汰赛。赛事于2009年12月22日至23日在东京后乐园大厅举行，为期两晚。参赛选手来自日本多个职业摔角团体，这是赛事停办五年后恢复举办，上一届于2004年举行。

en.s: Final Battle 2011 was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by Ring of Honor. It took place on December 23, 2011 at the Manhattan Center in New York City. It was the tenth annual event in the Final Battle chronology, with the first taking place in 2002, but only the third to be broadcast live. All three Ring of Honor (ROH) championships were contested at the event. The ROH World Championship was defended in a rubber match between champion Davey Richards and former champion Eddie Edwards; Edwards lost their previous match in June 2011 but won their first encounter in March 2010.

zh.s: ROH于2011年12月23日在纽约市曼哈顿中心举办《终极之战2011》付费直播赛事。这是该系列第十届年终赛事，但仅是第三次进行现场直播。ROH的三项冠军头衔都在本场赛事中进行争夺。ROH世界冠军戴维·理查兹与前冠军埃迪·爱德华兹进行三番战：爱德华兹在2011年6月的上一场对决中落败，但在两人2010年3月的首次交手中获胜。

en.s: The December 2011 Nigeria clashes happened in several towns in northern Nigeria in late December 2011, within the context of the Boko Haram insurgency. A major confrontation between suspected Boko Haram members and security forces broke out in the city of Damaturu on 22 December 2011 and continued into the next day. Army sources confirmed they had killed at least 50 militants during the two-day battle, over-running an insurgent base and munitions depot.

en.s: The Sabiha Gökçen Airport bombing took place on 23 December 2015 in the apron area of Sabiha Gökçen International Airport in Istanbul, Turkey. The explosion, which occurred at approximately 02:05 local time, wounded two airport cleaners, one of whom later died after being taken to hospital. Flights from the terminal resumed as normal while Binali Yıldırım, the Minister of Transport, Maritime and Communication, claimed that there had been no security lapses at the airport.

zh.s: 2015年12月23日，伊斯坦布尔萨比哈·格克琴国际机场的飞机停机坪发生爆炸，约在当地时间凌晨2时05分，两名机场清洁工受伤，其中一人送医后死亡。航站楼航班照常运行。时任交通、海事与通信部长比纳利·耶尔德勒姆称，机场没有发生安全疏漏。

It was played between the champions of the 2019–20 Primeira Liga and winners of the 2019–20 Taça de Portugal, Porto, and the runners-up of the Taça de Portugal, Benfica, on 23 December 2020. Porto won the match 2–0 to secure their second Supertaça title in three years and extend their record to 22 titles overall.

zh.s: 2020年坎迪多·德·奥利维拉超级杯是第42届赛事，于2020年12月23日举行。葡超冠军兼葡萄牙杯冠军波尔图对阵葡萄牙杯亚军本菲卡，最终以2比0获胜。这是波尔图三年内第二次夺得该项赛事冠军，也将其总冠军数刷新至22次。

en.s: The ENDF National Unity Offensive was a military offensive in the Tigray War launched by the Ethiopian military (ENDF) and pro-government forces to recapture territory in the Amhara and Afar regions being occupied by the Tigray Defense Forces (TDF). Gendarmerie regional forces and local militias from Afar and Amhara had mobilized thousands of fighters and joined the offensive. The ENDF and its allies were able to push TDF forces back from Debre Sina, Amhara to Alamata, Tigray (≈400 km). The Ethiopian government announced the campaign for national unity was a success and had been completed on 23 December 2021.

zh.t: 埃塞俄比亚国防军国家团结攻势
zh.s: 在提格雷战争期间，埃塞俄比亚国防军（ENDF）和亲政府部队发动国家团结攻势，试图从提格雷国防军（TDF）手中夺回阿姆哈拉和阿法尔地区的领土。阿法尔和阿姆哈拉地区的宪兵部队及地方民兵动员数千人参战。ENDF及其盟军把TDF从阿姆哈拉的德布雷塞纳一路击退至提格雷的阿拉马塔，推进约400公里。埃塞俄比亚政府于2021年12月23日宣布，这场国家团结行动已成功完成。

en.s: On December 23, 2021, jihadists from Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin and Ansarul Islam attacked Burkinabe forces in Titao, Loroum Province, Burkina Faso, killing 41 soldiers. The attack was one of the deadliest attacks against Burkinabe soldiers in the country's history, and occurred just over a month after an attack on Inata killed over fifty soldiers. News of the attack sparked protests across Burkina Faso.

zh.s: 2021年12月23日，“伊斯兰与穆斯林支持组织”和安萨鲁伊斯兰组织的武装人员在布基纳法索洛鲁姆省蒂陶袭击布基纳法索军队，造成41名士兵死亡。这是该国历史上针对军人的伤亡最惨重的袭击之一；一个多月前，伊纳塔袭击已造成50多名士兵死亡。袭击消息传出后，布基纳法索多地爆发抗议。

en.s: Harmony Jets Flight 185 was a charter flight from Ankara Esenboğa Airport, Turkey to Mitiga International Airport, Tripoli, Libya. On 23 December 2025, the aircraft operating the flight, a Dassault Falcon 50, crashed shortly after takeoff. The aircraft was carrying the Libyan Army chief Mohammed Ali Ahmed al-Haddad, three crew members, and four other passengers. All passengers and crew were killed.
